# `api.jobs.shipment.save_shipping_export_data`

> `POST /job/{jobDisplayId}/shipment/exportdata/{shippingId}` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.jobs.shipment.save_shipping_export_data(job_display_id: int, shipping_id: int, **kwargs: Any) -> None
```

**CLI**

